lines.zh: : 为什么？……
: 为什么？……

lines.en: : There’s nothing I can say that will make it any less painful.
lines.zh: : 无论我说什么，都不会让它不那么痛。

lines.en: : Send us back...
lines.zh: : 送我们回去……

lines.en: : I can’t.
lines.zh: : 我做不到。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend6
: Why?! You’re the one who brought us there!
lines.zh: : 为什么？！是你把我们带到那儿去的！

lines.en: : Where’s your door?! I want to go back! I want to see my daughter!
lines.zh: : 你的门在哪儿？！我要回去！我要见我的女儿！

lines.en: : That Himawari is gone now...
lines.zh: : 那个 Himawari 已经不在了……

lines.en: : You will have to make do with this one.
lines.zh: : 你们只能将就着接受这一个了。

lines.en: : What do you mean “gone?!” What did you do?! Where did she go?!
lines.zh: : 什么叫「不在了」？！你做了什么？！她去哪儿了？！

lines.en: : She was never anywhere to begin with.
lines.zh: : 她从一开始就不曾真正存在于任何地方。

lines.en: : Neither of you were.
lines.zh: : 你们俩也是。

lines.en: : And if I didn’t get you out of there, I would have never seen you again.
lines.zh: : 而如果我没把你们从那儿弄出来，我就再也见不到你们了。

lines.en: : I apologize for being so selfish. And for all the pain that I have caused you.
lines.zh: : 我为我的自私道歉。也为我给你们造成的全部痛苦道歉。

lines.en: : I am a terrible, horrible waste of a girl.
lines.zh: : 我是个糟糕透顶、一文不值的废物女孩。

lines.en: : You were never supposed to see that.
lines.zh: : 你们本来不该看到那一幕的。

lines.en: : See what?! A happy ending?! So you had to bring us back here?!
lines.zh: : 看到什么？！一个幸福结局？！所以你非得把我们带回这里？！

lines.en: : Would it have been too much to just let us have that?! Have we done something to deserve this punishment?!
lines.zh: : 让我们留住那个结局，就这么过分吗？！我们是做了什么，才该受这种惩罚？！

lines.en: : Ayane...I’m sure it isn’t like that.
lines.zh: : Ayane……我敢肯定不是那样的。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend7
: How can you say that?! We just watched her delete our daughter and our life in less than ten seconds and now we’re right back where we started!
lines.zh: : 你怎么能这么说？！我们刚刚眼睁睁看着她把我们的女儿、我们的人生在不到十秒内删掉，现在又回到了原点！

lines.en: : That is our daughter. She’s right there.
lines.zh: : 那就是我们的女儿。她就在那儿。

lines.en: : Right, Himawari? It’s still you, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 对吧，Himawari？还是你，对不对？

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend8
: I’m not allowed to answer that question.
lines.zh: : 我不被允许回答那个问题。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : I’m still me...
lines.zh: : 我还是我……

lines.en: : But I’ve robbed you of the only bit of happiness that you have ever had.
lines.zh: : 可我夺走了你们仅有的一点幸福。

lines.en: : And for that, I don’t deserve to call myself your daughter. Nor do I deserve to appear before you at all.
lines.zh: : 就凭这一点，我不配自称你们的女儿。我甚至不配出现在你们面前。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend9
: But I’m running out of options...and you’re running out of time. So I don’t know what to do anymore! I keep making mistakes!
lines.zh: : 可我已经没多少办法了……而你们的时间也不多了。所以我真的不知道该怎么办了！我一直在犯错！

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend10
: How are we running out of time here and not the other way around?...
lines.zh: : 为什么是这里的时间不够，而不是那边？……

lines.en: : This life was inescapable until you showed up. Then you finally got us out and now you’re telling us it’s all going to come to an end?
lines.zh: : 在你出现之前，这种生活根本逃不出去。然后你终于把我们弄出来了，现在却又告诉我们一切都要结束了？

lines.en: : Then why not let it end where we were happy? As a family?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不让我们在幸福的地方结束？作为一家人？

lines.en: : I don’t want my final days to be here...
lines.zh: : 我不想在这里度过最后的日子……

lines.en: : I want to see Aomori again...
lines.zh: : 我想再看看 Aomori……

lines.en: : Himawari, when you say we’re running out of time-
lines.zh: : Himawari，你说我们时间不多了——

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend11
: I mean that this place should not exist either.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，这个地方本来也不该存在。

lines.en: : And that soon, someone like me is going to come and cleanse it.
lines.zh: : 而且很快就会有像我一样的人来把它清理掉。

lines.en: : There will be no more “resets” like you call them. No more chances to start over. And the two of you will go back to where you’re meant to be.
lines.zh: : 不会再有你们所谓的「重置」了。不会再有重新开始的机会。而你们俩会回到你们本该在的地方。

lines.en: : Which is...where?
lines.zh: : 那是……哪儿？

lines.en: : That’s what I’m trying to figure out.
lines.zh: : 这正是我在想办法弄清楚的事。

lines.en: : Because I can help...but not if I don’t know where to take you. And just shoving you into another world puts everyone there in jeopardy if someone finds out.
lines.zh: : 因为我可以帮忙……但我得知道该把你们带到哪儿。而只是把你们硬塞进另一个世界，一旦被人发现，那边所有人都会有危险。

lines.en: : Is that...why we had to leave? We were...putting Hima-chan in jeopardy?
lines.zh: : 所以……这就是我们必须离开的原因？我们……在把 Hima 酱置于危险中？

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend12
: Not...exactly.
lines.zh: : 也……不全是。

lines.en: : What was that then? Where were we? Because you made it sound like it was just going to be dark when we walked through that door and not the literal perfect world we found ourselves in.
lines.zh: : 那到底是怎么回事？我们当时在哪儿？因为你把穿过那扇门说得好像只是一片黑暗，而不是我们后来置身其中的那个字面意义上的完美世界。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend13
: Heh...it was perfect, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 呵呵……那里很完美，对吧？

lines.en: : Spending every day together...hanging out on the couch and watching TV...going to arcades and restaurants all the time...eating Mom’s breakfast every morning...
lines.zh: : 每天都在一起……窝在沙发上看电视……动不动就去游戏中心和餐厅……每天早上吃妈妈做的早餐……

lines.en: : I’d give anything to exist there.
lines.zh: : 只要能存在于那里，我愿意付出一切。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend14
: That’s why I made it.
lines.zh: : 所以我才造了它。

lines.en: : What?...
: That’s my world.
lines.zh: : 那是我的世界。

lines.en: : My wish.
lines.zh: : 我的愿望。

lines.en: : A place outside of everything — where the three of us can be happy.
lines.zh: : 一个在一切之外的——我们三个可以幸福的地方。

lines.en: : A place that feels like it moves, where the seasons change and people grow. But it’s just like this one at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 一个看起来在流动的地方，那里四季更替、人会长大。但说到底，它跟这个世界没什么两样。

lines.en: : A lie based on a desire. An endless yearning for a positive outcome, granted physical form for no reason other than to make one person happy. But that sort of thing always comes with a caveat.
lines.zh: : 一个建立在欲望之上的谎言。对美好结局的无尽渴望，被赋予了实体的形态，理由仅仅是想让一个人幸福。可这种东西，总是带着附加条件。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend15
: You thought it when you woke up there, right? That it all seemed too good to be true?
lines.zh: : 你们在那儿醒来的时候就想过吧？这一切好得不像真的？

lines.en: : Yeah...and I feel pretty vindicated in thinking that right now. What do you mean you made it, though? You just...wished it and it happened?
lines.zh: : 是啊……而我现在觉得自己当初那么想是相当正确的。不过你说你「造了它」是什么意思？你就……许了个愿，然后它就成真了？

lines.en: : That’s the short explanation, yeah. The longer one gets deep into the machinations of various gods in different tiers of godliness who treat this place more like a sandbox than an actual universe.
lines.zh: : 简短版就是这样，对。长篇版要扯到不同神格层级的各路神明的种种算计，他们看待这地方更像一个沙盒，而不是一个真正的宇宙。

lines.en: : Are you saying you’re...a god?
lines.zh: : 你是说你是……神？

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend16
: Me? No. Of course not.
lines.zh: : 我？不。当然不是。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t mean I don’t work with them.
lines.zh: : 但这不代表我不跟他们共事。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend17
: You...
: Sorry. You work with gods?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你跟神明一起工作？

lines.en: : Mhm! Not directly, but under the same parent company.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！不是直接的，但在同一家母公司旗下。

lines.en: : I’m sort of a...celestial custodian or something along those lines. I clean up worlds that...well, require cleaning.
lines.zh: : 我算是个……天界清洁工之类的吧。我负责清理那些……嗯……需要清理的世界。

lines.en: : But after a certain point, some worlds just aren’t worth cleaning anymore.
lines.zh: : 不过到了某个程度，有些世界就不值得再清理了。

lines.en: : Think of it like a...server for a game that nobody wants to play or something. That just gets shut down after a while because it’s effectively dead.
lines.zh: : 可以把它想成……一款没人想玩的游戏的服务器之类的。过一阵子就被关掉了，因为它实际上已经死了。

lines.en: : And those worlds are the result of...wishes?
lines.zh: : 那些世界是……愿望的产物？

lines.en: : There’s a real world too, of course. At least on a technical level.
lines.zh: : 当然，也有一个真实的世界。至少在技术上来说有。

lines.en: : But the vast majority of worlds are born from wishes, yes. The sad part is that, most of the time, the people who wish for them don’t even know it.
lines.zh: : 但绝大多数的世界都诞生于愿望，没错。可悲的是，大多数时候，许下愿望的人自己都不知道。

lines.en: : So they live and die in the world where they made a wish while a second version of them reaps the benefits of their desires. It’s all super complex and weird. Orientation for the job is rough.
lines.zh: : 于是他们在自己许愿的那个世界里生老病死，而另一个版本的自己则在享受他们欲望的果实。这一切都复杂又诡异得要命。这行的入职培训可真够呛。

lines.en: : If there’s a real world, though...isn’t that where we’re from?...Can’t we all go there together and just...start over?...
lines.zh: : 可是如果有真实的世界……那不就是我们来的地方吗？……我们不能一起去那儿，然后……重新开始吗？……

lines.en: : You’d think. But normal people aren’t allowed there. It’s reserved for the gods. Not even us custodians are allowed to see it.
lines.zh: : 你会这么想。但普通人不能去那儿。那是给神明留的。连我们这些清洁工都不准看。

lines.en: : But, from what I hear, we’d probably go blind if we could. So I guess it’s sort of good that they don’t let us in.
lines.zh: : 不过听人说，要是真看到了，我们大概会瞎掉。所以他们不让我们进去，某种程度上也算是好事。

lines.en: : So...you’re saying...
lines.zh: : 所以……你的意思是……

lines.en: : This world is a wish too?
lines.zh: : 这个世界也是某个愿望？

lines.en: scene black
: That’s right...
lines.zh: : 没错……

lines.en: : But here’s where things start to get really messy.
lines.zh: : 不过接下来事情就开始变得非常麻烦了。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend18
: Because it’s not just worlds that are born from wishes.
lines.zh: : 因为诞生于愿望的不只是世界。

lines.en: : Sometimes, people are too. Or things. Hell, even Kit-Kat flavors could be zapped into reality if someone wishes for them hard enough.
lines.zh: : 有时候人也是。或者东西。见鬼，就算有人足够强烈地许愿，连 Kit-Kat 的新口味都能被凭空变出来。

lines.en: : But we all only get one. And since most of us use them without even knowing, the vast majority wind up as different worlds or people. Things that humans deeply desire.
lines.zh: : 但我们每个人只有一个。而既然大多数人都是在不知不觉中用掉了它，绝大多数愿望最后就变成了不同的世界或不同的人。变成人类深深渴望的东西。

lines.en: : Now, Father — let’s say I’m the result of a wish. Which I’m not, just to clarify. I’m your real, blood-related future daughter. Your genes swim through me like tilapia in the Nile.
lines.zh: : 那么，父亲——假设我是某个愿望的产物。先声明，我不是。我是你真正的、有血缘关系的未来女儿。你们的基因在我体内游动，就像尼罗河里的罗非鱼。

lines.en: : But let’s say I was. From your standpoint as a regular law-unabiding gentleman, if I wished deeply enough for something as a wish myself, what do you think would happen?
lines.zh: : 但假设我是。从一个普通的、不怎么守法的绅士——也就是你——的角度来看，如果我自己作为一个愿望，又深深地许下了一个愿望，你觉得会发生什么？

lines.en: : Probably...nothing? There wouldn’t be enough “custodians” to clean anything up if the universe could snowball like that.
lines.zh: : 大概……什么都不会发生？如果宇宙能那样滚雪球，那「清洁工」再多也不够用。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend19
: Exactly. And why we’re all secretly hoping in the office that more people start wishing for Kit-Kats.
lines.zh: : 正是。这也是为什么办公室里大家都偷偷盼着更多人开始许愿要 Kit-Kat。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend20
: But, let’s say it did work.
lines.zh: : 不过，假设它真的成了。

lines.en: : That somehow, there was a wish that wished so strongly, it defied the logic of this world and broke the very laws that gave it life in the first place.
lines.zh: : 假设有那么一个愿望，许得如此强烈，以至于违背了这世界的逻辑，打破了最初赋予它生命的法则本身。

lines.en: : What then?
lines.zh: : 那会怎样？

lines.en: : I don’t know, Himawari...
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Himawari……

lines.en: : Do you think that the ones in control of this universe would allow something like that to exist? Something that, at least on paper, is more powerful than they are?
lines.zh: : 你觉得掌控这个宇宙的存在，会允许那样的东西存在吗？一个至少在纸面上比他们更强大的东西？

lines.en: : Probably...not? Most of the gods I’ve met haven’t exactly seemed rational or understanding. But it’s possible they’d keep an eye on it to-
lines.zh: : 大概……不会？我见过的神明大多都算不上理性或通情达理。不过他们也许会盯着它，以防——

lines.en: : That.
lines.zh: : 就是这个。

lines.en: : That’s exactly it.
lines.zh: : 一点没错。

lines.en: : They’d keep an eye on it. Make sure nothing gets out of hand.
lines.zh: : 他们会盯着它。确保一切不会失控。

lines.en: : But even their time isn’t infinite. And once it’s no longer reasonable or even entertaining to do so, there’d be no reason to keep it. Or even give it room to grow.
lines.zh: : 但连他们的时间也不是无限的。而一旦这么做不再合理、甚至不再有趣，那就没有理由继续留着它了。更不会给它生长的空间。

lines.en: : Now, based on everything I just said-
lines.zh: : 那么，根据我刚才说的这些——

lines.en: : What kind of world do you think this is?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这个世界是什么样的世界？

lines.en: : I...get what you’re saying. But who-
lines.zh: : 我……明白你的意思。可是谁——

lines.en: : You know exactly who. But in the event that I really am just infinitely smarter than you, allow me to spell it out.
lines.zh: : 你很清楚是谁。不过万一我真的比你聪明无限倍，那就容我把话挑明。

lines.en: : Maya Makinami does not exist.
lines.zh: : Maya Makinami 根本不存在。

lines.en: : This is a world of her creation. One that breaks so many rules that I can’t even trace where it comes from.
lines.zh: : 这是一个由她创造的世界。它打破的规则太多了，多到我甚至追查不出它的来源。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend21
: And it’s because of that that I’m having so much trouble helping you and Mom.
lines.zh: : 也正因为如此，我在帮你们和妈妈这件事上才这么困难。

lines.en: : If I only knew where you were before here, I’m sure I could get you out.
lines.zh: : 只要我知道你们在这儿之前是在哪儿，我肯定能把你们弄出去。

lines.en: : I might lose my job in the process, sure. But that’s obviously a risk I’m willing to take if it means saving-
lines.zh: : 过程中我可能会丢掉工作，没错。但如果那意味着能救——这个风险我显然愿意承担。

lines.en: : That’s enough.
lines.zh: : 够了。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend22
: What do you mean that’s enough? I’m breaking like a thousand laws by just telling you this. If anyone finds out I did, I’m-
lines.zh: : 你「够了」是什么意思？光是告诉你们这些，我就违反了一千条规矩。要是有人发现是我干的，我就——

lines.en: : I understand.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend23
: You...
: You do?
lines.zh: : 你真的明白？

lines.en: : Not perfectly. But I know you wouldn’t lie to me. And I don’t want what little time I have left with you before you leave again to be filled with corporate, religious psychobabble.
lines.zh: : 不完全明白。但我知道你不会对我撒谎。而我不想让你再次离开之前，我们仅剩的那点时间，被公司和宗教的胡言乱语填满。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend24
: You do have to leave again, right?
lines.zh: : 你还是要再走的，对吧？

lines.en: : They’re catching on...
lines.zh: : 他们开始察觉了……

lines.en: : They know how much time I spend here now.
lines.zh: : 他们知道我现在在这儿待多久了。

lines.en: : I’m not supposed to come at all anymore. I can’t just...leave you guys alone, though. I worry too much and-
lines.zh: : 我本来已经完全不该来了。可我没法就这么……丢下你们不管。我太担心了，而且——

lines.en: : You never have to explain yourself to me, Himawari. You could lead me off a cliff for all I care.
lines.zh: : 你永远不必向我解释，Himawari。你就算把我引下悬崖，我也不在乎。

lines.en: : I’ll follow you anywhere. Whether it be this world or-
lines.zh: : 你去哪儿我都跟。不管是这个世界，还是——

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend25
: Aomori?...
lines.zh: : Aomori？……

lines.en: : Or Aomori...
lines.zh: : 还是 Aomori……

lines.en: : You’d take me there again?...
lines.zh: : 你愿意再带我去那儿？……

lines.en: : Even after what I did?...
lines.zh: : 就算我做了那些事？……

lines.en: : It’s your wish, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那是你的愿望，对吧？

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend26

lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: : It’s...the reason I do this...
lines.zh: : 那是……我做这一切的理由……

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend27
: I, uhh...
: I don’t think Mom is on the same page right now, though...
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得妈妈现在想法不太一样……

lines.en: scene black
: Ayane...what are you doing?
lines.zh: : Ayane……你在做什么？

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend28
: She’s still here. We still have time with her.
lines.zh: : 她还在。我们还有时间和她在一起。

lines.en: : Not...much, though. I, uhh...
lines.zh: : 不过……不多了。我，呃……

lines.en: : I have cleaning duty again. No one’s touched this place since I made you guys walk through Despacito.
lines.zh: : 我又轮到清洁任务了。自从我让你们走进 Despacito 之后，这地方就没人动过。

lines.en: : I can’t do it...
lines.zh: : 我做不到……

lines.en: : It hurts too much...
lines.zh: : 太痛了……

lines.en: : I know...
lines.zh: : 我知道……

lines.en: : But what I know even more is how much you’ll regret letting this chance slip through your fingers.
lines.zh: : 但我更清楚的是，你要是让这个机会从指缝间溜走，会有多后悔。

lines.en: : Everything slipped through my fingers...
lines.zh: : 一切都从我指缝间溜走了……

lines.en: : It was all right there...I can still see it...
lines.zh: : 一切明明就在那儿……我现在都还能看见……

lines.en: : I didn’t even turn the stove off...and Hima-chan has clothes in the dryer...
lines.zh: : 我连炉子都没关……Hima 酱的衣服还在烘干机里……

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend29
: I had work today...
lines.zh: : 我今天还要上班……

lines.en: : I don’t know what happens if I don’t show up...
lines.zh: : 我不知道我要是不去会怎么样……

lines.en: : Ayane...
lines.zh: : Ayane……

lines.en: : What’s gonna happen if she comes back home and no one’s there to greet her?...
lines.zh: : 要是她回到家，却没有人迎接她，会怎么样？……

lines.en: : I, uhh...
: I’m gonna...head over to the beach and...start cleaning up now...
lines.zh: : 我要……去海边……开始清理了……

lines.en: : But I should have a little time left over to come back and...
lines.zh: : 不过我应该还能剩下一点时间回来……

lines.en: scene black
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: My feet move on their own.
lines.zh: 我的双脚自己动了起来。

lines.en: And, for once, I'm thankful for that.
lines.zh: 而这一次，我为此心怀感激。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend30
: I’m coming with you.
lines.zh: : 我跟你一起去。

lines.en: : You’re...
: You’re what?
lines.zh: : 你什么？

lines.en: : Coming with you. Pay more attention.
lines.zh: : 跟你一起去。上点心。

lines.en: : I was, just...
lines.zh: : 我有在听，只是……
: 为什么？……

lines.en: : Because I’ll regret it if I don’t. And I want to see my daughter at work.
lines.zh: : 因为不去我会后悔。而且我想看看我女儿工作的样子。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : What about Mom? You’re just...going to leave her here?
lines.zh: : 妈妈怎么办？你就……把她留在这儿？

lines.en: : She’ll come to her senses soon. And if for some reason she doesn’t, we can just turn this into another date.
lines.zh: : 她很快就会想通的。万一她没有，我们就把这次也变成一次约会好了。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend31
: And get totally smashed in the purikura booths?...
lines.zh: : 然后在大头贴机里喝个烂醉？……

lines.en: : That’s how we do it.
lines.zh: : 我们一向如此。

lines.en: : You know my job isn’t exactly...pretty, right? Like, I’m...going to be reformatting all of your...uhh...
lines.zh: : 你知道我的工作不太……好看，对吧？比如，我要把你们所有的……呃……

lines.en: : Friends is just...what I’ll call them.
lines.zh: : 「朋友们」……我就这么称呼他们吧。

lines.en: : I just watched my daughter get turned into TV static. I think I can handle a little reformatting.
lines.zh: : 我刚看着我女儿变成了一片电视雪花。我觉得我受得住一点格式化。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend32
: Hahah! Yeah...probably a walk in the park after that.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！是啊……在那之后，大概就跟逛公园一样轻松。

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend33
: Are you ready to go now then? I can introduce you to one of my friends.
lines.zh: : 那你现在准备好走了吗？我可以介绍你认识我的一位朋友。

lines.en: : You have friends? Since when? It better not be a boy.
lines.zh: : 你有朋友？从什么时候开始的？最好别是个男的。

lines.en: : It’s a girl. Shi-chan. She’s off limits, though. So don’t even think about it.
lines.zh: : 是个女生。Shi 酱。不过她你可别碰。想都别想。

lines.en: : She...works for the same, uhh...company then?
lines.zh: : 她……也在同一家……呃……公司上班？

lines.en: scene beginningoftheend34
: She’s my senpai and she’s super cool! I got to shadow her for the first month and she’s, like...totally dead inside.
lines.zh: : 她是我的前辈，而且超酷！第一个月我跟着她实习，而她……怎么说呢……内心彻底死透了。

lines.en: : Oh. Cool.
lines.zh: : 哦。挺酷。

lines.en: scene black
: You know, I have a friend like that too. She’s-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我也有个这样的朋友。她是——

lines.en: : Wakana Watabe! I know! Want me to transform into her? Look!
lines.zh: : Wakana Watabe！我知道！要我变成她的样子吗？看！

lines.en: : How the-
lines.zh: : 这到底——

lines.en: : Oh, right. You wouldn’t remember I can do that. Uhh...surprise! Oh, I can also basically watch your entire life in real time from an app on my phone. Wanna see?
lines.zh: : 哦，对。你不记得我能这么做了。呃……惊喜吧！哦，我还基本可以用手机上的一个 app 实时观看你的整个人生。想看看吗？

lines.en: : You can do what?
lines.zh: : 你能做什么？

lines.en: : Yeah. You’re a real scumbag like 99%% of the time, Dad. I had to turn parental controls on just so I wouldn’t accidentally see you getting it on with one of your students again.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你有 99%% 的时间都是个不折不扣的人渣，爸爸。我不得不打开家长控制，就为了不让自己不小心又看到你跟某个学生上床。

lines.en: : I’m going to need you to delete that app from your phone.
lines.zh: : 我需要你把那个 app 从手机里删掉。

lines.en: : Nooo, I need it for work! And for spying. Anyway, ready to learn about another one of my cool custodial powers?
lines.zh: : 不要嘛，我工作要用！还有偷看要用。总之，准备好见识我的另一个超酷清洁工能力了吗？

lines.en: : You’re not the one that’s been causing my blackouts, are you? Is there a button in your app for that?
lines.zh: : 我那些昏厥不是你搞的吧？你那个 app 里有这种按钮吗？

lines.en: : God, I wish. That’d be so funny. This power is way more convenient, though. Want to say goodbye to Mom?
lines.zh: : 天啊，我也希望是。那一定很好笑。不过这个能力方便多了。想跟妈妈说再见吗？

lines.en: : Ayane, last chance. Are you sure you don’t want to-
lines.zh: : Ayane，最后的机会。你确定不想——

lines.en: : Just go...
lines.zh: : 走吧……

lines.en: : I can’t do it...
lines.zh: : 我做不到……

lines.en: : Hah...
: In that case — away! To a more depressing daddy-daughter date! Take my hand.
lines.zh: : 既然如此——出发！去一场更丧的父女约会！抓住我的手。

lines.en: : Like this? What are we-
lines.zh: : 这样吗？我们要——

jump undeservedfuture11
